title: The silent struggle: Why male infertility is a hidden crisis
desc: For couples struggling to have children, questions about fertility can sting. What sounds like concern to the person asking can feel like a painful reminder of a deeply private struggle. What is rarely asked is whether the problem could lie with the man.
